addr: 549A, 9th A Main Rd, Hoysala Nagar, Indiranagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560038, India

rev.t: One of my favorite bookstores in Namma Bengaluru. Although it’s quite noisy compared to Vasantha nagar one, it offers a cosy place to read, munch and spend time in your own ways.

A really cosy, cottage-core kind of place in the heart of Indira nagar. We obviously need more such places that encourage book browsing and reading and I've no complaints about the book selection. The seating area of the cafeteria is lovely …
Very nice and cozy place to seat and spend time with book and having coffe. They have such a nice collection of children Book.
